prompts.Fabricator: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: finished square pixel-art game background for Emberveil, a bleak post-apocalyptic A Dark Room game, displayed at 350x350 logical pixels. Primary request: a salvaged alien fabricator installed inside a dark weathered timber-and-stone workshop. Center a large ancient manufacturing machine, two thick oxidized green-grey metal pillars holding a circular focusing head above an EMPTY recessed work bed; slender cables, aged brass fittings, tiny restrained amber status lamps. Machine occupies x=22-78%, y=23-82%, clearly readable silhouette. Old plank floor, rough rear wall, piles of unworked dull alloy at far edges, a small side workbench, dusty window with cold dusk light. Front-facing slightly elevated view, restrained handcrafted 16-bit pixel art, crisp clustered square pixels, no smooth gradients, no blur, no realistic photo noise. Muted charcoal, pine grey, old olive metal, pale bone highlights and sparse warm amber. Quiet, mysterious, utilitarian, no humans, no floating weapons or completed products, no writing, no UI, no logos or borders. Full bleed opaque square composition, clearly drawn subject even in shadows. Create a single finished background, not a sheet.
prompts.Ship: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: square finished pixel-art game background, Emberveil post-apocalyptic game, reduced in game to 350x350 logical pixels. Primary request: a derelict small single-person wanderer spacecraft on improvised landing supports in a barren forest clearing at blue dusk. Ship design MUST be readable: narrow long pointed pale olive-grey nose pointing toward TOP of picture, dark teal cockpit centered high on fuselage, two broad short angular swept-back wings, paired dark engine pods at lower left and lower right, aged cream dorsal stripe, patched metal plates and worn rivets. Entire spacecraft fits in central x=22-78%, y=18-80%, viewed from slightly raised three-quarter near top-down, symmetrical plan with depth. On ground with engines OFF; no exhaust or active beam. Simple low repair trestles and rolled cable at ground edges, rusty discarded hull plates, distant dark pines framing edges and low rocky mountains beyond. No people. Restrained handcrafted 16-bit game pixel art with crisp clustered square pixels, muted charcoal, grey-green, dusty brown ground and a few amber work lamps. Full bleed opaque square, no UI, no text, no labels, no border, no smooth digital painting, no blur. A desolate salvage site with a single ship as the visual focus, no huge hangar or futuristic city.
prompts.Flight: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one TRANSPARENT game sprite atlas. A 2 by 2 grid with four clearly separated objects, wide empty transparent gutters and margins. Top-left cell: a small old wanderer spacecraft viewed EXACTLY top-down, nose pointing straight up, narrow pointed cream/olive-grey fuselage, dark teal canopy, short broad swept-back wings, paired black engine pods at rear corners, patched metal, no flame or shadow. Strong symmetrical readable silhouette; nose at top, engines bottom. Top-right: a single elongated grey-brown asteroid, roughly rectangular tall mass with blunt corners, craters and chipped edges. Bottom-left: a second tall rusty rocky asteroid, different outline. Bottom-right: a third tall dark-grey craggy asteroid. All three rocks have roughly WIDTH:HEIGHT = 20:37, solid continuous mass fills each bounding rectangle nearly fully; opaque interior. No backgrounds or atmospheric effects. Pixel art 16-bit game sprites with crisp hard pixel clusters, muted earth/olive/charcoal palette, light from upper left, readable at tiny resolution. True transparent alpha everywhere outside objects, no checkerboard, no captions, no panels or divider lines. Each object centered in its own quadrant, entirely separate from others, no touches/cropping. One single atlas PNG.
prompts.Return: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: finished square 16-bit pixel-art ending scene for a bleak post-apocalyptic game. The wanderer's tiny patched olive-grey single-seat spacecraft has escaped a dead rocky planet: viewed from behind and slightly above, triangular pointed fuselage aiming away toward upper center, dark teal canopy, short swept-back wings and twin rear engine pods glowing softly amber. It is small at x=45-55%, y=62-75% of image. Huge curved rim of the barren dark grey planet occupies the bottom quarter; thin cold blue atmosphere and a loose belt of rocky debris recede below the ship. The upper two thirds are quiet black-blue space, tiny sparse stars, a few distant specks. The mood is solitary escape, silence and vastness, no fleet, no rescue, no celebratory sunburst, no people. Restrained muted slate blue/charcoal/olive/bone with very sparse amber. Crisp clustered square pixel art like a handcrafted 350x350 logical-pixel game background, full bleed square, opaque, no text, no UI, no border, no blur or smooth painting.
prompts.Fleet: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: finished square 16-bit pixel-art ending scene for a bleak post-apocalyptic game. The silent abandoned wanderer homefleet: colossal scarred dead worldships drifting in deep black-blue space amid sparse debris. Three or four dark immense asymmetric hull silhouettes in the upper and middle distance, broken segmented armor, empty ribs and damaged towers. NO lit city windows, no active beams, no bright engine flares or rescue party; these are dead ships. A tiny lone patched olive-grey triangular single-seat craft with short swept-back wings and twin engine pods appears low foreground at x=45-55%, y=75-85%, travelling toward them, its small blue beacon now dim. Strong scale contrast and great negative space, desolate ominous quiet, the air running out, cold cabin, not triumphant. Muted charcoal and slate blue, desaturated pale bone highlights, sparse rust scars, no vivid neon. Crisp handcrafted square pixel clusters intended to reduce to 350x350 logical pixels. Full bleed opaque square background, no writing, no UI, no border, no blur, no smooth painterly rendering.
